summary: The L’Ouverture Economic Development Plan for Haiti Act of 2025 authorizes the creation of a Haitian American Enterprise Fund to support sustainable economic development, private sector growth, and infrastructure improvement in Haiti.

affected_groups.effect: Receive investments, loans, grants, equity, and technical assistance to support micro, small, and medium enterprises, agriculture, and manufacturing industries.
affected_groups.group: Haitian private sector businesses and workers

affected_groups.effect: Benefit from improvements in physical infrastructure, including electricity access, roads, water and sanitation systems, and health and education programs.
Engage in potential U.S.-Haitian joint ventures, financial instruments, and collaboration activities with the Government of Haiti and the business community.

key_provisions: Authorizes the President to designate a private, nonprofit organization as the Haitian American Enterprise Fund for Haiti, operated by the Chief Executive Officer of the United States International Development Finance Corporation.
Establishes a 9-member Board of Directors Oversight Panel appointed by the CEO and the President to monitor the Enterprise Fund.
Authorizes investments in micro, small, and medium businesses, agriculture, manufacturing, energy, and physical infrastructure projects such as electricity grids, roads, and water systems.
Authorizes appropriations of $1,000,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031 to carry out the Act.
Requires the Enterprise Fund to undergo annual independent private audits and audits by the Government Accountability Office.
Requires the Chief Executive Officer and Oversight Panel to submit annual reports on the Fund's activities, successes, failures, and financial conditions to Congress and the public.
Sets a termination date of December 31, 2031, by which the Fund must repay the full amount of funds received from the U.S. government to the Treasury and terminate operations.
missing_information: Specific criteria for how the initial nonprofit organization will be selected by the President beyond general capability requirements.
Exact details on the specific financial instruments and structures that will be made available to private investors.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The L’Ouverture Economic Development Plan for Haiti Act of 2025 authorizes the creation of a Haitian American Enterprise Fund to support sustainable economic development, private sector growth, and infrastructure improvement in Haiti.
summary_detail.significance: The bill establishes a government-backed, multi-billion-dollar enterprise fund aimed at fostering industrialization, private sector development, and infrastructure in Haiti while managing irregular migration flows. The measure authorizes a total of $6,000,000,000 in appropriations across six fiscal years.

title: L’Ouverture Economic Development Plan for Haiti Act of 2025
